## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services.csproj` — Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`**

The `UserService.cs` file uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`JObject`, etc.) but `Services.csproj` has no `<PackageReference>` for it. This produces 3 errors:

| Error | Location | Message |
|-------|----------|---------|
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(2,7) | `using Newtonsoft.Json;` — namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(3,7) | `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;` — namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(22,19) | `JObject` type not found |

### Cascading Failure

- **`Api.csproj`** depends on `Services.csproj` via `<ProjectReference>`. It was **never compiled** because its dependency failed first. It has no errors of its own.

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

**`Core.csproj` compiled successfully** — no issues there.
